fixes: On Android, share files, pictures and links from other apps to Mewla, or open a file with Mewla: they arrive in Brain's composer as attachments.
Screen: a page an agent left on your Mac takes your taps in order and tells you when it can't. A window you are watching keeps the Mac awake.
When Claude or Codex stops answering, Brain says so in one line, and your Work waits instead of failing. It carries on when the answers come back.
Work that is really done closes itself, and you can reopen it. A wait now has an end, and the ones that run past it reach Brain once a day, in one list.
Calendar is the first row of your computer's page, with today's count.
AWS, Google Cloud and Google Workspace are set up the first time you use them, not at start. If setup fails, the card says why.
A scheduled action runs on the model you chose for it.
An open Brain terminal follows Brain after a restart.
On Android, updating from the app opens the installer alone, not a list that also offers Mewla.
